candidates.title: Will Oliver Bearman beat Nico Hulkenberg in the Sao Paulo Grand Prix?
candidates.rules_primary: If Oliver Bearman achieves a better finishing position than Nico Hulkenberg in the Grand Prix at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix originally scheduled for November 8, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
Additional Clarifications:
Non-Participation: If one or both competitors don't participate (not entered, withdrawn, or absent), all markets resolve to a fair market price.
Both Disqualified (DSQ): If both competitors are disqualified (DSQ), all markets resolve to 50/50.
One Disqualified (DSQ): If only one competitor is disqualified (DSQ), that competitor resolves to No.
Both Did Not Start (DNS): If both competitors did not start the session (DNS), all markets resolve to 50/50.
One Did Not Start (DNS): If one competitor did not start (DNS) and the other starts, the competitor that started resolves to Yes.
Both Did Not Finish (DNF): If both competitors start the race but neither finishes (both DNF), the competitor who completed more full laps resolves to Yes.
One Finishes, One Doesn’t (DNF): If one competitor is classified as a finisher and the other isn't, the finisher resolves to Yes.
Both Finish: If both competitors finish the session, the competitor with the better position resolves to Yes.
Identical Results: If both competitors achieve identical results (same position, same laps, etc.), all markets resolve to 50/50.
Outcome Hierarchy: Classified finish > DNF (by laps) > DNS > DSQ
